requests.purpose: NVDA representation lookup; BSC identities compared

queryParameters.tokenContractAddresses: the two BSC NVDA representations returned by request 5; address values omitted

methodology.uniqueDirectoryRepresentations: Count distinct normalized BSC asset identities (chainId plus lowercase token contract address) in the returned token-list rows.
methodology.platformBreakdown: Group those distinct identities by the returned platformId.
methodology.recognizedStatuses: Count returned rows whose market status normalized to a recognized closed or offhours value; rows without a recognized value are counted separately.
methodology.quoteAgeMs: At observation time, subtract each returned tokenPriceUpdatedAt from the probe observation epoch timestamp.
methodology.sourceValuesRetained: Only bounded aggregate results are retained; raw responses, individual provider quote timestamps, and token contract addresses are omitted, so a public reader cannot independently recompute every aggregate from this file alone.

limitations: The 57-record difference is unexplained; provider pagination and total-count semantics are unverified.
Equal identity sets for two tabId values do not prove that the filter is ignored or establish filter semantics.
Directory rows did not include per-token quote-update timestamps or liquidity; 46 rows lacked a recognized market status.
The two sampled quote ages do not establish a freshness service-level agreement or acceptable maximum age.
This is a single bounded observation, not a complete catalog or a recurring measurement.

The public aggregate record documents query parameters and calculation methods, but omits raw rows and selected token identities; full independent recomputation requires a new authorized read-only observation.
